# tenancy.UnitTypeDefinition

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A unit type registered by an application module; the core registers none.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `tenancy.UnitTypeDefinition` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
